definitions.gloss: Mount Kōya, center of Shingon Buddhism
definitions.explanation: A mountain in Wakayama Prefecture where {空海|くうかい} founded the headquarters of Shingon Buddhism in 816. More than a hundred temples stand on its summit plateau, and visitors can stay overnight in temple lodgings.

examples.japanese: {高野山|こうやさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
{高野山|こうやさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宿坊|しゅくぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a temple lodging on Mount Kōya.

examples.japanese: {高野山|こうやさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥之院|おくのいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{空海|くうかい}→空海：31131_kuukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{瞑想|めいそう}→瞑想：13660_meisou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信|しん}じられている→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: At Okunoin on Mount Kōya, Kūkai is believed to be still in meditation.

notes:
The "mountain" is a plateau ringed by peaks rather than a single summit.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {宿坊|しゅくぼう}: temple lodging, with vegetarian ⟦{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}→精進料理：16101_shoujinryouri⟧ and morning prayers
- {奥之院|おくのいん}: the inner sanctuary and vast cemetery around Kūkai's mausoleum
- ⟦{高野豆腐|こうやどうふ}→高野豆腐：07948_kouyadoufu⟧: freeze-dried tofu, named after the mountain

CULTURAL NOTE:
It became part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2004.
